limits.title: California microbial limits
limits.text: Not detected in 1 g: STEC E. coli and Salmonella (all products); pathogenic Aspergillus fumigatus, flavus, niger, terreus (inhalable products).

limits.title: USDA hemp total THC formula and 0.3% dry-weight limit
limits.text: Total THC = 0.877 × THCA + Δ9-THC; hemp must test at or under 0.3% on a dry-weight basis (after measurement uncertainty).

limits.title: New federal hemp definition (Dec 11, 2026)
limits.cite: P.L. 119-37 Div. B § 781, as delayed by P.L. 119-103 (CRS IF13136)
limits.text: From Dec 11, 2026: final hemp products over 0.4 mg combined total THC (and similar cannabinoids) per container are no longer hemp; total THC including THCA must be 0.3% or less by dry weight. From Nov 12, 2026: cannabinoids that the plant cannot naturally make are excluded.
